test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The volume of a right circular cone is 1078 cm³. Find the total surface area of the cone if its height is 21 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Volume** V = (1/3) × π × r² × h ⇒ 1078 = (1/3) × (22/7) × r² × 21

r² = 1078 ÷ 22 = 49 ⇒ **Radius (r)** = 7 cm

**Slant height (l)** = √(h² + r²) = √(21² + 7²) = √(441 + 49) = √490 = 7√10 cm

**TSA** = πr(r + l) = (22/7) × 7 × (7 + 7√10) = 22 × 7(1 + √10) = 154(1 + √10) cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 154(1 + √10) cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Volume of cone = 1078 cm³, Height (h) = 21 cm, π = 22/7

**Formula Used:** Volume = (1/3)πr²h, Total Surface Area (TSA) = πr(r + l), Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab7d0f21b2792069a8699b3410713418ca28e3b628b5c7c31006cc966bf5b4e0.png] 

⇒ 1078 = (1/3) × (22/7) × r² × 21

⇒ 1078 = 22 × r²

⇒ r² = 1078 ÷ 22 = 49

⇒ Radius (r) = 7 cm

⇒ Slant height (l) = √(7² + 21²) = √(49 + 441) = √490 = 7√10 cm

⇒ TSA = πr² + πrl = πr(r + l)

⇒ TSA = (22/7) × 7 × (7 + 7√10)

⇒ TSA = 22 × 7(1 + √10) = 154(1 + √10) cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 154(1 + √10) cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Cone

The relationship between height (h), radius (r), and slant height (l) is given by Pythagoras theorem: l = √(r² + h²).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The lateral surface area or CSA of a right circular cone is given by the formula πrl.

Volume of a Cone

The volume of a cone is exactly one-third of the volume of a cylinder with the same base and height: V = (1/3)πr²h.</p
